power.answer: Kuwait Airways' own battery document could not be loaded, so this page uses the ICAO rule that took effect on 27 March 2026: a passenger may carry at most two power banks and may not recharge them during the flight. Confirm the watt-hour limit with Kuwait Airways.

faq: How many power banks can I take on Kuwait Airways?
The ICAO standard from 27 March 2026 limits passengers to two; Kuwait Airways' own rule could not be read.
Can I charge my power bank on a Kuwait Airways flight?
Under the ICAO standard, passengers are prohibited from recharging power banks during flights.
